name: Wasser-Shuriken
description: You fire a barrage of sharp shurikens at a target. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately strike again for another 1d4 {type} damage. Repeat this process up to a total of four times, stopping early if you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll.
